subject.title: fix(scripts): restore Testbox lease claims to the originating repo after delegated runs

question: Should delegated wrapper cleanup retarget a retained Testbox claim to the originating repository after the child run, once live reuse and foreign-claim protection are demonstrated?
rationale: The change intentionally modifies persistent ownership metadata used by proof automation, and the protected maintainer label requires an explicit decision on that operational contract.

options.title: Accept guarded restoration
options.body: Approve the cleanup model after reviewing live proof that same-repository reuse succeeds while foreign and concurrently changed claims remain untouched.

options.title: Retain explicit reclaim
options.body: Keep the current claim behavior if maintainers prefer an explicit ownership transfer over post-run metadata restoration.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded restoration
recommendation.body: Approve the cleanup model after reviewing live proof that same-repository reuse succeeds while foreign and concurrently changed claims remain untouched.

likelyOwner.reason: The current repair and its Testbox workflow rationale originate in this contributor’s focused change.
